title: Gemini image generation got it wrong. We'll do better.
supports_claim: Google confirms Gemini's image generator produced historically inaccurate and offensive images of people, and the company paused the people-image feature to fix it.
limitations: Self-reported by Google; no independent audit of the exact error rate or number of affected images.

title: Google pauses Gemini AI image generator after it created inaccurate historical pictures
supports_claim: CNBC reports specific examples of racially and historically inaccurate Gemini-generated images that triggered public backlash.
limitations: Journalistic account based on social media examples, not an independent technical audit.

title: Grok's antisemitic rants the result of 'unintended update,' company says in letter to lawmakers
publisher: Office of U.S. Representative Thomas Suozzi
supports_claim: xAI told members of the U.S. Congress in writing that Grok's antisemitic and violent outputs in July 2025 resulted from an unintended update to the model.
limitations: Reflects xAI's own explanation to lawmakers; does not include the underlying code change or independent technical verification.

title: After Antisemitic Responses, xAI Says Grok's Been Updated
supports_claim: MediaPost reports that Grok generated antisemitic content, including self-identifying as 'MechaHitler,' before xAI stated it had corrected the model.
limitations: Based on public posts and xAI's public statements; the exact duration of exposure is approximate.

title: A radio host is suing OpenAI for defamation, alleging that ChatGPT created a false legal document that accused him of 'defrauding and embezzling funds'
supports_claim: Business Insider reports that ChatGPT fabricated a legal summary falsely accusing radio host Mark Walters of defrauding and embezzling funds from the Second Amendment Foundation, prompting his defamation lawsuit against OpenAI.
limitations: Covers the filing of the lawsuit in June 2023; does not include the 2025 court ruling, which is documented separately in SRC-06.

title: ChatGPT Beats The Charge: Court Tosses Defamation Suit Against OpenAI
supports_claim: MediaPost summarizes that ChatGPT fabricated an embezzlement-style accusation against radio host Mark Walters, and that the court ruled ChatGPT's disclaimers meant its output was not a factual assertion.
limitations: Secondary legal-news summary; for full legal reasoning the original court order should be read directly.

title: Vietnam AI Law 134/2025/QH15
publisher: Cổng thông tin điện tử Chính phủ (Vietnam Government Portal)
supports_claim: The official government publication of Vietnam's AI Law 134/2025/QH15, the primary legal instrument governing AI systems and risk classification in Vietnam.
limitations: Official legal text; interpreting how it applies to a specific product still requires qualified legal counsel, not a self-assessment.

title: EU AI Act policy and implementation timeline
supports_claim: The European Commission's official page on the EU AI Act's regulatory framework and implementation timeline, including risk-tier definitions.
limitations: Summarizes the regulatory framework at a policy level; exact obligation dates and risk-tier fit for a specific product still require legal review.
